name: v0.7.9
body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v0.7.9 -->

## What's Changed
### Features
* feat(modify): add and remove published ports by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1789
* feat(sdk): expose retained sandbox exit outcomes by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1812
* feat(network): return JSON policy denials by default by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1825
* feat(exec): add optional output backpressure by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1832
* feat(sdk): apply label modifications live on running sandboxes by @TheRealSibasishBehera in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1881
* feat(config): restrict backends and add context commands by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1898
* feat(network): add HTTP CONNECT proxy basic authentication - #78 by @gregwebs in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1868
### Fixes
* fix(db): preserve SQLite locks during macOS identity checks by @x0day in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1787
* fix(snapshot): avoid duplicate catalog entries after import by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1802
* fix(runtime): take metrics snapshots off the runtime workers by @0xpolarzero in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1807
* fix(exec): reject signals promptly after execution ends by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1810
* fix(runtime): discard late bulk finishes after cancellation by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1816
* fix(network): release completed published TCP connections by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1815
* fix(cli): shorten default storage usage output by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1820
* fix(runtime): deliver bulk failures without waiting for finish by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1822
* fix(runtime): preserve live legacy startup endpoints by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1823
* fix(network): preserve ipv4 fallback when ipv6 stalls by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1824
* fix(installer): resolve relative install paths before changing directory by @GoldArowana in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1830
* fix(runtime): preserve partial relay frame reads across wakeups by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1838
* fix(agentd): replace the CA bundle atomically by @TheRealSibasishBehera in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1856
* fix(sdk): refuse reserved label keys in modify by @TheRealSibasishBehera in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1857
* fix(sdk-node): encode consumer paths when resolving bundled binaries by @GoldArowana in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1833
* fix(sdk): refuse env the guest cannot boot with by @TheRealSibasishBehera in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1863
* fix(cli): keep secret substitution on plain modify by @TheRealSibasishBehera in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1842
* fix(volume): retain local record until file removal succeeds by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1873
* fix(ci): improve runner disk cleanup by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1895
* fix(exec): bound command buffers without stalling shared transport by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1839
* fix(env): set the last entry of a repeated env key by @TheRealSibasishBehera in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1893
* fix(snapshot): inspect archive metadata before deferred extraction by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1903
### Documentation
* docs: sync mintlify updates to main by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1814
* docs(cli): list secret options in command help by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1828
* docs: sync published mintlify updates into main by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1885
### Dependencies
* chore(deps): Bump the "dependencies" group with 2 updates across multiple ecosystems by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1853
* chore(deps): bump webpki deps by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1894
* chore(deps-dev): Bump the npm_and_yarn group across 2 directories with 1 update by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1892
* chore(deps): Bump @vitest/mocker from 5.0.1 to 5.0.5 in /packages in the npm_and_yarn group across 1 directory by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1896
### Build
* build(kernel): update firmware to Linux 6.12.113 by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1876
### Tests
* test(network): cover HTTP CONNECT handshake and harden status parsing by @gregwebs in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1819
### Maintenance
* chore: refresh lockfiles after v0.7.8 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1808
* chore(docs): add documentation skill by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1869
* chore(release): bump microsandbox to 0.7.9 by @appcypher in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1829
### Other changes
* revert(exec): remove unreleased output backpressure by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1875

## New Contributors
* @GoldArowana made their first contribution in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1830

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/compare/v0.7.8...v0.7.9
